# Sizes of the RG-19A messages (generated by skinproto.py)

Stand-in signatures of the exact FIPS 204 size. Skin link messages carry a `16` byte tag.

| message | bytes | round trip |
|---|---|---|
| writer_grant | 4720 | ok |
| writer_take_over | 2544 | ok |
| skin_link_lost | 31 | ok |
| session_pause | 2885 | ok |
| session_resume | 2784 | ok |
| PairingRecord (chain payload) | 4799 | ok |
| SkinAttach (Skin link) | 62 | ok |
| SkinAttachAck (Skin link) | 45 | ok |
| ViewBind (Skin link) | 41 | ok |
| ViewUnbind (Skin link) | 24 | ok |
| SkinEvent (Skin link) | 32 | ok |
